mapper.select: select count(1) from mall_member_favorite where member_id=#{memberId} and spu_id=#{spuId}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_member_favorite(member_id,spu_id,product_name_snapshot,subtitle_snapshot,product_image_snapshot,price_snapshot,create_time) values(#{memberId},#{item.spuId},#{item.productName},#{item.subtitle},#{item.mainImage},#{item.price},now()) on duplicate key update product_name_snapshot=#{item.productName},subtitle_snapshot=#{item.subtitle}, product_image_snapshot=#{item.mainImage},price_snapshot=#{item.price}
mapper.delete: delete from mall_member_favorite where member_id=#{memberId} and spu_id=#{spuId}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_member_browse_history(member_id,spu_id,product_name_snapshot,subtitle_snapshot,product_image_snapshot,price_snapshot,first_view_time,last_view_time,view_count) values(#{memberId},#{item.spuId},#{item.productName},#{item.subtitle},#{item.mainImage},#{item.price},now(),now(),1) on duplicate key update product_name_snapshot=#{item.productName},subtitle_snapshot=#{item.subtitle}, product_image_snapshot=#{item.mainImage},price_snapshot=#{item.price},last_view_time=now(),view_count=view_count+1
